svg.title: Control nodes: parallel group, foreach and loop
svg.desc: The executor normalizes authored steps into action, parallel-group, foreach and loop nodes. Foreach fans a collection out through a bounded dispatch engine into per-item sub-pipelines; a loop repeats its body until its exit gate passes or maxIterations is reached.
svg.text: Control nodes: action, parallel group, foreach, loop
normalizeNodes builds these from authored order; loops and foreach bodies run steps through the same dispatch as top-level steps.

g.title: One ordinary step. entryGate is the only gate a step declares; it is not evaluated on a foreach controller (put it on the children).
g.text: StepSkippedEvent, advance; otherwise dispatch one step

g.title: A non-parallel step, loop or foreach ends the group. Pause or cancel during the group keeps its operator-driven status. parallel is ignored inside loops.
g.text: adjacent parallel: true steps, Future.wait, results merged in step order;
blocking failure keeps _parallel.failed.stepIds, run fails or pauses

g.title: An empty list succeeds with an empty result. A missing or non-list key fails the controller.
g.text: context list (or a one-key object wrapping a list, e.g. story_specs.items)

g.title: iteration_dispatch_engine.dart. max_parallel is an integer, "unlimited" or a template; omitted means 1. A dependency cycle is rejected at dispatch time. First hard failure cancels pending iterations; in flight ones settle.
g.text: in flight <= min(max_parallel, runner capacity); inline worktree forces 1
DependencyGraph: item id + dependencies, dispatched when prerequisites done

g.title: Bare child output keys are visible to later siblings and isolated from plan-level context until the iteration ends. Nested foreach is not allowed. Tokens per child are recorded as <childId>[<i>].tokenCount.
g.text: overlay = copy of context + map; child steps run in order,
each child entryGate-guarded; may contain a nested loop

g.title: Failed slots hold {error, kind, message, task_id}; kind is the persisted discriminator resume reads.
g.text: one list under the controller output, index-ordered, keyed by child step id

g.title: WorkflowExecutionCursor.loop and _loop.current.* are set at the start of every iteration and after each step, so recovery can tell before first step, mid-iteration, and after iteration before the exit decision.
g.text: cursor = loop id, n, step id; entryGate checked: false on n=1 skips the loop

g.title: A failing body step follows its onError policy (the run fails by default). continueSession cannot cross the loop boundary.
g.text: normal step dispatch; outputs merged and persisted after every step

g.title: Evaluated every iteration after the body, even the first. GateUnproducedOutputFailure fails the run when a gate reads an output a failed step never produced.
g.text: true: done. false: next iteration (arrow on the left edge)

g.title: LoopIterationCompletedEvent fires each iteration with the gate result.
continue falls through to the next node (top-level loops only). escalate settles the foreach item as needsInput (foreach-nested loops only). The validator enforces the scope.

svg.text: Hover (direct view) for invariants and file details.
